description: 臺北市南港車站特定專用區區段徵收範圍開發前後地號資料 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府地政局土地開發總隊. 臺北市南港車站特定專用區區段徵收範圍開發前後地號資料. Coverage: 臺北市政府地政局土地開發總隊. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府地政局土地開發總隊. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
